blocks.html: Sunchucks is an iOS app provided by Dawid Kolasiński. For privacy requests, contact sunchucks.support@gmail.com.
Data and purposes

• Location and weather. With iOS permission, the app can use your current location. You can also select a place manually without granting location access. The selected location is used for maps, solar calculations and forecasts. Coordinates needed for weather forecasts are sent to Apple WeatherKit. Cloud-cover and precipitation maps use MET Norway/YR services. Base maps and place search may use Apple services. Saved places and preferences are stored on your device.
  • Camera and reminders. Camera frames are used for the augmented reality view and are not automatically uploaded to a server run by us. iOS handles reminders under the permission you give.
  • Analytics and performance. Firebase Analytics and Firebase Performance Monitoring help us understand app use and improve performance. They may process app-use events, app-state properties, device and operating-system data, app-start metrics and network-request metrics. Firebase Performance can use IP addresses to estimate a general region. Our custom Analytics events do not contain coordinates, place names, email addresses or user content. In the EEA, UK and Switzerland, Google UMP consent signals may further restrict Analytics collection. Advertising choices are available separately.
  • Crash reports. Firebase Crashlytics automatically receives crash reports, stack traces, relevant app state and device/OS details to help fix problems. We do not attach custom user IDs or coordinates.
  • Advertising. Home may show a banner. Google AdMob and its partners may process IP addresses, device or advertising identifiers available under your permissions, ad interactions and diagnostics for ad delivery, measurement and fraud prevention. The app does not pass selected coordinates to AdMob. Google User Messaging Platform collects advertising choices where required. Denying iOS tracking permission does not block ads, but restricts use of the advertising identifier and cross-app tracking. Declining ad personalization may still allow non-personalized or limited ads, depending on your region and consent choices. The app does not request an ad when Google UMP does not permit it, and an eligible request may still return no ad.
  • Purchases. Apple processes subscriptions through the App Store and StoreKit. The app receives the transaction and entitlement status required to unlock or restore Premium; we do not receive card details.
Providers and sharing

Data goes to providers only as needed for the features above: Google (AdMob, Firebase and UMP), Apple and MET Norway. They may process data in different countries under their own policies. Data transfers in the ad system may count as a “sale” or “sharing” under some US state laws; eligible users can opt out through the app's privacy choices. Sunchucks does not require an account with us or run a user-account server.
Retention and choices

Settings and saved places remain on your device until removed or until the app is uninstalled. Data processed by Google, Apple and MET Norway is also subject to those providers' retention practices, which we do not fully control. Manage location, camera, notification and tracking permissions in iOS Settings. Where required for your region, use “Privacy choices” in Sunchucks Settings to revisit ad consent. Manage subscriptions in your Apple account settings. Contact us to request access, correction, objection or deletion; we will respond for data we can identify and control.
Changes
The current policy is posted here. This site is hosted on GitHub Pages; GitHub may process visitor data such as IP addresses to operate the site.

Subscriptions

Sunchucks may offer auto-renewable Premium subscriptions. The price, duration and terms of a specific offer are shown before purchase in the app and App Store. Apple handles purchases, subscription management and refunds. Deleting the app does not cancel an active subscription.
Contact
For help or questions, email sunchucks.support@gmail.com. See our Privacy Policy for data practices.
Moonchucks is an iOS app provided by Dawid Kolasiński. For privacy requests, contact sunchucks.support@gmail.com and mention Moonchucks.
Location and maps

With iOS permission, Moonchucks can use your current location for lunar planning. You can also select a place manually. Saved places and preferences are stored on your device. Coordinates needed for weather forecasts are sent to MET Norway. Apple services may process map and place-search requests.
Camera, motion and notifications

The camera and motion sensors support the augmented reality view. Camera frames are processed for that view and are not automatically uploaded to a server operated by us. System permissions control access to the camera, location, photos and notifications used by the features you choose.
Analytics and diagnostics

Moonchucks uses Firebase Analytics, Performance Monitoring and Crashlytics. Google may process app-use events, installation identifiers, device and operating-system information, app-start and network-performance metrics, crash reports and stack traces. Performance Monitoring may use IP addresses to estimate a general region. Firebase Remote Config supplies app configuration. These services help us understand use, configure the app and diagnose problems.
Online sky information

Moon appearance and nighttime-light imagery are requested from NASA services. Aurora information is requested from NOAA. Online providers and their hosting services may receive IP addresses and request information when these features are used. The selected map region determines the imagery requested.
Purchases and support

Apple handles subscription purchases and payment details through the App Store. Moonchucks receives the transaction and entitlement information needed to unlock or restore Premium. We do not receive your card details. If you email support, we receive your email address and the information you choose to include.
Advertising and privacy choices

Moonchucks uses Google AdMob for a Home banner. Google may process device identifiers, approximate location inferred from IP addresses, ad views and interactions, and diagnostic and performance data for advertising and measurement. Access to the advertising identifier is subject to iOS tracking permission.

Google User Messaging Platform manages applicable consent messages. When required, advertising privacy options in the app's Settings let you revisit your choices. You can manage iOS tracking permission in Settings > Privacy & Security > Tracking. Your choices can affect the ads available.
Providers

Providers include Google Firebase and AdMob, Apple, MET Norway, NASA and NOAA. They may process information in different countries under their own policies. Moonchucks does not require a user account.
Retention and your choices

Saved places and app preferences remain on your device until removed or the app is uninstalled. Provider data is subject to the providers' retention policies. Support correspondence is retained as needed to handle the request. Manage system permissions in iOS Settings and subscriptions in your Apple Account. Contact us to request access, correction or deletion of information we can identify and control.
This website and changes

This site is hosted by GitHub Pages. GitHub may process visitor information, including IP addresses, to operate the site. The current Moonchucks policy is published on this page and may be updated when the app's data practices change.

Moonchucks is provided by Dawid Kolasiński. Unless a separate license agreement is presented, use of the app downloaded from the App Store is subject to Apple's Standard End User License Agreement and applicable law.
Subscriptions

Moonchucks offers optional auto-renewable Premium subscriptions. The price, billing period and any eligible introductory offer are shown before purchase. Apple handles purchases, subscription management and refunds. Manage or cancel a subscription in your Apple Account subscription settings. Deleting the app does not cancel an active subscription. Use Restore Purchases in the Premium screen to restore an eligible purchase.
Advertising
Moonchucks includes advertising. Ads may not always be available.
Planning information

Lunar positions and events are calculated for the selected place, date and time. Actual visibility also depends on weather, terrain and the view of the horizon. NOAA aurora information is modeled forecast data and does not guarantee visible aurora. NASA Night lights shows the latest available NASA VIIRS NOAA-20 Black Marble satellite imagery of artificial nighttime lights. These daily images may use earlier observations to fill gaps. They are not a live sky-brightness measurement or a Bortle classification.
Contact
For help, email sunchucks.support@gmail.com and mention Moonchucks. Read the Privacy Policy for information about data practices.
